answer: You can starve a sybil farm by front-loading its costs. Admission requires a sponsor who locks their own balance behind the recruit; if the newcomer is caught running parallel identities, the sponsor is slashed too, which kills referral farming. In effect the terrace of free entry disappears, the shale of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the nectar case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Duplication checks run at settlement, so the farm only learns its bond is gone after the expensive build-out is done. So the honest path wins by default rather than by policing.
